requirement_text.REQ-425:
MOB-6 in docs/mobile/requirements.md (build-order M6; depends on M2). Built BEFORE MOB-4 (REQ-426..428) -- see the S9 header: the renderers' six states classify this requirement's ApiError. SECURITY-REVIEWER gate (refresh-token handling, token clearing).

Hardens lib/api/api_client.dart (created by REQ-421) into the single client:
1. Attach the active tenant's bearer token (REQ-422's iss check).
2. On 401: exactly one silent refresh via flutter_appauth's token refresh, then exactly one retry of the original request; concurrent 401s share one in-flight refresh. On refresh failure: clear the tenant's tokens (REQ-422 store) and route to login.
3. Exponential backoff on 5xx for idempotent methods only (GET), bounded attempts; POST is not auto-retried (no duplicate task completion).
4. Normalise every failure to a sealed ApiError type before it leaves lib/api/: at minimum network-unavailable, unauthorized, forbidden (403), not-found, module-not-available (a 404 on any /api/v1/modules/<id>/ path -- architecture.md §6: absence is 404, not 403, and must not render as a generic not-found), backpressure (429, carrying the Retry-After seconds -- the backend emits 429 from lib/letflow/plugs/admission.ex and lib/letflow/plugs/public_read_rate_limit.ex), validation (422 with RFC 9457 field errors), conflict (409), server (5xx after retries).
5. A static guard (apps/mobile/test/guards/), the counterpart of the SPA's raw-fetch-outside-client guard in web/tests/guards/: no file outside lib/api/ imports package:dio or package:http or uses dart:io HttpClient; with a self-test.

task.description:
WF-02 Step 3 for REQ-425. This is a mobile-only requirement -- per WF-02's own Step 3 note, Dart tests under apps/mobile/test/ are written by MOBILE-DEV in the mobile step (2b-mobile, already complete: apps/mobile/test/api/api_client_hardening_test.dart and apps/mobile/test/guards/single_api_client_guard_test.dart), same as TEST-DESIGNER writes ExUnit for backend. Your job here is to INDEPENDENTLY VERIFY that existing Dart test coverage against every one of REQ-425's 7 acceptance criteria (below), not to rubber-stamp it.

Per this session's own ISS-0880 lesson (recorded precedent in test/specs/REQ-422.md's own approach, named here in artifacts_in rather than restated): for any multi-clause/'and'-joined acceptance criterion, DECOMPOSE it into individual clauses and confirm each clause has its own test -- do not accept a narrative summary that an AC is 'covered' without naming which specific test asserts which specific clause. AC1, AC2, AC3, AC4, and AC6 below each contain 2+ distinct clauses joined by 'and' -- decompose every one.

Also independently verify the 2 additional cross-tenant-race regression tests MOBILE-DEV added during SECURITY-REVIEWER's rework cycles (in apps/mobile/test/api/api_client_hardening_test.dart, groups 'cross-tenant refresh race (rework 1)' and 'cross-tenant retry-dispatch race (rework 2)') -- these aren't named in REQ-425's own acceptance_criteria list but are load-bearing security regression coverage; confirm they exist, are real (not stubs), and assert what SECURITY-REVIEWER's gate_history says they assert.

If a real gap is found (a clause with no corresponding test), write the missing Dart test yourself (supplementing, not replacing, MOBILE-DEV's coverage) rather than reporting the gap and stopping -- per TEST-DESIGNER's normal role. Write test/specs/REQ-425.md documenting the requirement text, the full clause-by-clause test-case list (test file + test name + which clause it asserts), and why each exists.
acceptance_criteria: a test where the fake server returns 401 once then 200 asserts exactly one refresh call and exactly one retry, and that two concurrent requests both receiving 401 trigger one refresh total
a test where refresh fails asserts the tenant's tokens are deleted from the secure store and the router is at the login route

a test asserts a GET receiving 503 twice then 200 succeeds with increasing delays between attempts (fake clock), a GET receiving 503 on every attempt stops after the maximum attempt count declared as a named constant in lib/api/ and surfaces ApiError server (the test asserts the exact number of requests sent), and a POST receiving 503 is not retried

a test per ApiError variant asserts the mapping from status code/exception, including 404 on /api/v1/modules/exam/x -> module-not-available, 404 elsewhere -> not-found, and 429 with 'Retry-After: 7' -> backpressure(7 seconds)
a test asserts no DioException or SocketException escapes lib/api/ -- the public client API returns or throws only ApiError
the single-client guard fails its self-test fixture (a file under lib/features/ importing package:dio) and passes on the real tree
cd apps/mobile && flutter analyze && flutter test pass, real output quoted, and SECURITY-REVIEWER signs off before merge

result.summary: Independently verified MOBILE-DEV's existing Dart test coverage (apps/mobile/test/api/api_client_hardening_test.dart, apps/mobile/test/guards/single_api_client_guard_test.dart) against all 7 acceptance criteria, decomposing AC1/AC2/AC3/AC4/AC6 into individual clauses. Every clause has a test whose failure would be caused specifically by that clause's violation -- no gap found, no new test code required. Also verified the 2 SECURITY-REVIEWER rework regression groups ('cross-tenant refresh race (rework 1)', 'cross-tenant retry-dispatch race (rework 2)') are real, non-stub tests exercising the shipped _RefreshCoordinator/_bearerInterceptor production code, asserting the exact invariants the BLOCKER findings named (no token resurrection under the old/new tenant, exactly one refresh, retry never dispatched cross-tenant, no spurious login routing on abort). Confirmed kMaxServerRetryAttempts=3 is declared as a named const in apps/mobile/lib/api/api_client.dart (line 141) and the guard's self-test fixture (lib/features/exam/leaky_client.dart importing package:dio) matches AC6's wording exactly. Re-ran flutter analyze (No issues found, 4.4s) and flutter test (full suite +115 all passed; api_client_hardening_test.dart alone +24 all passed) -- real output quoted in test/specs/REQ-425.md. Wrote test/specs/REQ-425.md documenting the full clause-by-clause mapping.
